spec.name: Earnings drift v13
spec.notes: Searched 189 variants of this signal; the figure quoted is the best of them and should be read with that in mind. The family has a long record as a premium.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.8, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 4%.

exhibits: The strategy was selected from 189 variants, which introduces significant selection bias and overfits the performance metrics to historical noise.

verdict.opinion: The strategy exhibits clear selection bias. By testing 189 variants and selecting the best-performing one, the reported Sharpe ratio of 1.8 is likely inflated and does not represent expected out-of-sample performance. While the underlying logic (earnings drift) is a known factor, the methodology used to arrive at this specific signal configuration is statistically unsound. I recommend paper trading to verify if the signal holds up in real-time market conditions before committing capital.
